title: Textream: free PromptSmart alternative
caption:
PromptSmart charges $9.99/month. Textream is a teleprompter that follows your voice, for free 🎬

✅ Word tracking: highlights each word as you say it
✅ Pinned under the MacBook notch, or a floating window
✅ Classic auto-scroll or voice-activated scrolling
✅ No subscription, no account, no ads, 100% free

💻 Mac · iPhone · iPad
ℹ️ The Mac app needs macOS 15 or later. iPhone and iPad come as a companion app in the same App Store listing. Word tracking uses Apple speech recognition, which may send audio to Apple

Comment "PROMPT" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
